data.desc: Prior to the adoption of the Company's Plan of Sale, Seritage was principally engaged in the ownership, development, redevelopment, management, sale and leasing of diversified retail and mixed-use properties throughout the United States. As of September 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio consisted of interests in eight properties comprised of approximately 0.7 million square feet of gross leasable area ('GLA') or build-to-suit leased area and 133 acres of land. The portfolio encompasses three consolidated properties consisting of approximately 0.2 million square feet of GLA and 51 acres (such properties, the 'Consolidated Properties') and five unconsolidated entities consisting of approximately 0.5 million square feet of GLA and 82 acres (such properties, the 'Unconsolidated Properties').
